scripts/swarm/ledger_host.py:scripts.swa.reason: Equivalent: the selector is the reflog selector of refs/remotes/origin/dev, a refname followed by one @{stamp} suffix. Git refnames may not contain the sequence @{ (git check-ref-format rejects refs/remotes/origin/a@{b with exit 1), so the selector holds exactly one @{ and partition and rpartition split it identically.
